entries.title: Hosea 14:1
segments: O Israel, return to the LORD your God, for you have fallen by your iniquity.

entries.title: Hosea 14:2
segments: Take with you words, and turn to the LORD. Say to Him, Take away all iniquity, and receive [us] graciously, that we may repay [with] the calves of our lips.

entries.title: Hosea 14:3
segments: Assyria shall not save us; we will not ride on horses. Nor shall we say any more to the work of our hands, Our gods, for in You the fatherless finds mercy.

entries.title: Hosea 14:4
segments: I will heal their backslidings; I will love them freely; for My anger has turned away from him.

entries.title: Hosea 14:5
segments: I will be as the dew to Israel; he shall grow as the lily and cast out his roots like Lebanon.

entries.title: Hosea 14:6
segments: His branches shall spread, and his beauty shall be as the olive tree, and his smell as Lebanon.

entries.title: Hosea 14:7
segments: They who dwell under his shadow shall return; they shall revive like the grain, and grow like the vine. Their scent [shall be] as the wine of Lebanon.

entries.title: Hosea 14:8
segments: Ephraim [shall say], What [have] I to do any more with idols? I have heard [him] and watched him; I [am] like a green fir tree. Your fruit is found from Me.

entries.title: Hosea 14:9
segments: Who [is] wise, and he shall understand these things? Understanding, and he shall know them? For the ways of the LORD are right, and the just shall walk in them; but sinners shall fall in them.
